title: Rapidgzip: Parallel Decompression and Seeking in Gzip Files Using Cache Prefetching
relevance: Uses cache prefetching as a core architectural pattern for parallel gzip decompression, achieving 8.7 GB/s with 128 cores.

title: Performance Optimization for Relative-Error-Bounded Lossy Compression on Scientific Data
relevance: Demonstrates table-lookup-based precomputation and Huffman traversal reduction for accelerating decompression in SZ framework. 80% decompression speedup.

title: An Efficient High-Throughput LZ77-Based Decompressor in Reconfigurable Logic
relevance: FPGA-based LZ77 decompressor using 'refine and recycle' method for handling copy dependencies, achieving 7.2 GB/s per instance.
